title: 第二十一章 六命归一天启初启第二十二章 神域秘史背叛真相
slug: 星冕天启守护者觉醒录
lines: 暗黑结界碎裂的余风还在学生会会议室的窗棂间缓缓流淌，方才那场惊心动魄的激战尘埃落定。
穿透厚重黑雾的天光澄澈透亮，温柔铺满整间空旷静谧的会议室，将地面残留的细碎暗黑灵力碎屑映照得无处遁形。空气里还残留着雷霆炸裂的微凉气息、寒冰凝结的凛冽质感、红莲火焰的温热余韵，以及各路光明本源交融过后，澄澈干净的灵力余温。
历经三年自我禁锢、三年心魔缠身，御神苍瞬终究挣脱了过往所有的枷锁，彻底接纳了属于冰川时珩王族的宿命，以时之守护者的身份，真正站在了这片承载着宿命与羁绊的土地上。
六道挺拔修长的身影并肩伫立在会议室中央，六道截然不同却无比纯粹的光明本源之力，在无人操控的状态下，自发缓缓流转、遥遥呼应。
天野凛星周身萦绕的冰金圣光凛冽澄澈，凛冽寒冰裹挟着净化万物的圣光，是永霜天野家族世代传承的守护正道，沉稳厚重，浩然坦荡，稳稳撑起全队最坚实的根基。
藤咲若织身侧浮动的绛红火光温柔炽热，圣草的生机绵长不息，红莲净火的净化之力凛然刚正，一柔一刚交织相融，是水晶城王族最温柔也最坚韧的守护力量，包容万物，亦焚尽污浊。
海月涟音周身流转的苍碧水风轻灵浩荡，水流温润治愈，风刃凌厉破敌，双生本源相辅相成，自带抚平伤痛、稳住战局的磅礴气场，清和绵长，生生不息。
琉璃金朵萦绕周身的粉金岩土灵光厚重温润，金石锋芒暗藏于柔软土层之下，增益万物，禁锢邪祟，守护着世间所有细碎温柔，稳妥可靠，无声守护。
夜见幽弥身侧翻飞的幽紫幻影虚实莫测，幻影迷离惑敌，暗影内敛藏锋，是独属于暝夜璃影家族的特殊力量，清冷孤高，亦正亦邪，藏着不为人知的隐忍与伤痛。
最后苏醒的，是御神苍瞬周身流转的霆蓝时序雷光。时空深邃无垠，雷霆霸道凛然，双生顶级本源交织缠绕，带着跨越岁月、掌控时序的无上威仪，澄澈干净，却又蕴含着颠覆战局、逆转乾坤的无尽力量。
六大本源，六脉天命，跨越三年的蛰伏离散，跨越无数次的擦肩对峙、暗中守护、绝境相护，终于在这一刻，完完整整地汇聚于琉光星冕学园这间普通的会议室中。
六种色彩迥异、属性各异的光明灵力悬浮在六人周身半米之处，缓缓盘旋流转，起初只是各自独立运转，遵循着王族血脉与生俱来的本源规律静静浮动。不过数息，最细微的共鸣震颤从虚空深处悄然滋生。
最先呼应的是天野凛星的冰金圣光与御神苍瞬的时序雷光，寒冰的凛冽适配雷霆的清冽，时空的包容接纳圣光的浩然，两道顶级力量轻轻碰撞交融，泛起一圈细碎璀璨的光纹涟漪。
紧随其后，藤咲若织的红焰灵力顺势靠拢，草木生机滋养时序岁月，红莲烈火淬炼雷霆邪祟，完美填补了时雷之力缺少的净化生机。
海月涟音的水风之力随风而至，流水调和万物戾气，清风牵引灵力流转，让原本刚硬凌厉的冰、火、雷三系力量变得圆融通透，动静相宜。
琉璃金朵的土金本源稳稳垫底，厚重岩土扎根大地，稳固整片灵力声场，金石锋芒加固所有力量的壁垒，让六道本源的共鸣愈发稳固，再无溃散的可能。
最后，夜见幽弥飘忽不定的紫黑幻影之力缓缓融入光阵中央，虚实相生的幻术之力串联起六道本源的缝隙，让所有力量彻底融为一体，不分彼此，同心同源。
一声低沉悠远、源自天地本源的轰鸣，无声回荡在整片空间之中。
无人耳可闻，却深深震颤着在场每一位守护者的血脉神魂。
六域本源彻底共鸣，六命天命彻底归一。
萦绕在六人周身的六色光芒骤然暴涨，化作一道贯通天地的璀璨光阵，悬浮在会议室半空。冰白、绯红、苍碧、鎏金、幽紫、霆蓝六道流光层层交织、环环相扣，层层叠叠的灵力纹路复刻出上古天启星阵的雏形，古老、庄严、浩瀚、神圣。
沉睡在六人血脉深处，自三年前神域浩劫后便彻底沉寂的天启本源，在六脉王族力量圆满合一的瞬间，悄然苏醒。
细碎纯粹的天启星光从虚空之中洒落，温柔包裹住每一个人的身躯，顺着肌理血脉缓缓渗入体内。原本各自独立、进阶轨迹各不相同的本源灵力，在天启之力的滋养下，完成了最完美的适配与互通。
每个人的灵力运转速度都变得愈发顺畅，损耗多年的根基被温柔滋养，连日激战留下的细微伤势尽数抚平，体内沉寂多年的潜能被一点点唤醒、解锁。
属于完整天命战队的磅礴气场，轰然铺开，笼罩整栋学生会办公楼，温柔扩散至整座琉光星冕学园。
窗外原本随风摇曳的香樟枝叶骤然静止，林间飞鸟停落枝头，喧嚣的校园人声仿佛被无形屏障轻轻隔绝，整片天地都在为六命归一的天启盛景静默臣服。
天野凛星微微垂眸，感受着体内前所未有的充盈力量，以及血脉深处久违的圆满共鸣，冰蓝色的眼眸里翻涌着沉稳的欣慰与笃定。
三年孤身坚守，三年独自承压，三年看着同伴一一觉醒、陆续归队，今日终于集齐全员，凑齐六域天命，圆满了整片守护星轨。
他侧过眼眸，目光下意识落在身侧的藤咲若织身上。
少女绯霞渐变的长发被半空洒落的天启星光轻轻拂动，发尾细碎的火光与星光交织缠绕，温柔得近乎虚幻。她微微抬眸望着半空的天启光阵，澄澈的眼眸里盛满温柔的光亮，长长的眼睫轻轻颤动，侧脸线条温婉又坚韧。
天光落在她白皙的侧脸，勾勒出柔和的下颌线条，衬得她眉眼愈发温润动人。
天野凛星的心跳，在这一刻悄然慢了半拍。
周身浩瀚磅礴的天启灵力、关乎天下苍生的宿命大局、明暗对峙的沉重战局，在这一刻仿佛都悄然褪去了凛冽厚重的外壳，只剩下眼前少女温柔动人的模样，轻轻落在他眼底心底，漾开层层细碎的涟漪。
跨越日久的默默倾心，无数次绝境之中的并肩相护、暗中牵挂、无声守护，那些藏在沉稳克制之下的细碎情愫，在此刻漫天温柔星光的烘托下，愈发清晰、愈发滚烫，顺着血脉缓缓蔓延，温柔裹挟了整片心神。
他素来冷静自持、克制内敛，习惯将所有情绪、所有牵挂尽数藏于心底，从不外露半分。可此刻看着身旁并肩而立、与自己共承天命、共赴前路的少女，心底积压许久的温柔悸动，再也无法轻易掩盖。
温柔的暧昧氛围无声蔓延，萦绕在两人之间，清淡、绵长、真挚，不染浮躁，只余双向奔赴的赤诚与心动。
藤咲若织似是有所感知，微微侧首，恰好对上天野凛星望来的目光。
少年挺拔清隽的身姿立于天光之下，金调渐变的黑发被星光镀上一层柔和的鎏金，冰蓝色的眼眸澄澈干净，眼底没有战局的凌厉，没有宿命的沉重，只剩下独属于她的温柔与专注，纯粹而滚烫。
四目相对的瞬间，藤咲若织的心尖轻轻一颤，耳尖悄然染上一层淡淡的绯色。
她迅速收回目光，重新望向半空璀璨的天启星阵，看似神色平静、从容淡然，可微微颤动的眼睫，却悄悄泄露了心底的悸动与慌乱。
藏在温柔隐忍之下的双向情愫，无需言语，无需表露，便在无声对视之间，温柔升温，静静蔓延，成为这片沉重宿命之中，最温柔缱绻的一抹亮色。
身旁其余四人皆沉浸在天启之力滋养身躯、稳固本源的蜕变之中，无人察觉这转瞬即逝、温柔绵长的暧昧瞬间，唯有清风与星光，默默见证着两人深藏心底、双向奔赴的心意。
content_en:
The lingering wind from the shattered dark barrier was still slowly flowing through the window lattice of the student union conference room, and the dust of the thrilling battle just now had settled.
The skylight that penetrated the thick black fog was clear and bright, filling the entire empty and quiet conference room with gentleness, illuminating the fine debris of dark spiritual power remaining on the ground. There are still lingering in the air the cool breath of thunder, the cold texture of condensed ice, the warm aftertaste of red lotus flames, and the clear and clean residual warmth of spiritual power after the blending of various sources of light.
After three years of self-imprisonment and three years of inner demons, Yu Shen Cang Shun finally broke free from all the shackles of the past, completely accepted the fate of belonging to the Glacier Time Heng royal family, and truly stood on this land that carries fate and fetters as the guardian of time.
Six tall and slender figures stood side by side in the center of the conference room. The six completely different yet extremely pure powers of light flowed spontaneously and slowly without human control, echoing from afar.
The ice-gold holy light that surrounds Amano Rinxing is cold and clear, and the biting ice envelops the holy light that purifies all things. It is the guardian righteousness passed down from generation to generation by the Eternal Frost Amano family. It is steady, heavy, majestic and magnanimous, and firmly supports the most solid foundation of the entire team.
The crimson fire floating beside Fujisaki Wakaori's body is gentle and hot, the vitality of the sacred grass is endless, and the purifying power of the red lotus pure fire is awe-inspiring and upright. One softness and one hardness are intertwined. It is the gentlest and toughest protective force of the royal family of Crystal City. It tolerates all things and burns away the filth.
The blue water wind flowing around Haiyue Lianyin is light and powerful, the water flow is gentle and healing, and the wind blade is sharp to destroy the enemy. The twin origins complement each other, and have a majestic aura that heals pain and stabilizes the battle situation. It is pure and long-lasting, endless.
The aura of pink gold rock and earth surrounding the glazed golden flower is thick and warm. The edge of gold and stone is hidden under the soft soil layer, which enhances all things, confines evil spirits, and protects all the tenderness in the world. It is safe and reliable, and it protects silently.
The purple phantom flying around Yumi at night is unpredictable. The phantom is confusing and confuses the enemy. The shadow is restrained and hidden. It is a special power that belongs exclusively to the Mingye Liying family. It is cold and aloof, both good and evil, and hides unknown tolerance and pain.
The last thing to wake up was the thundering blue time sequence lightning that circulated around the body of Yu Shen Cang. Time and space are deep and boundless, the thunder is domineering and awe-inspiring, the twin top origins are intertwined, carrying the supreme majesty that spans the years and controls the time sequence, is clear and clean, but also contains the endless power to subvert the war situation and reverse the world.
The Six Origins and the Six Meridians of Destiny, which spanned three years of dormancy and separation, spanned countless confrontations, secret protections, and desperate situations, finally, at this moment, completely gathered in this ordinary conference room of Liuguang Xingmian Academy.
Six kinds of bright spiritual power with different colors and different attributes were suspended half a meter around the six people, slowly circling and flowing. At first, they were just operating independently, floating quietly following the original laws of the royal bloodline. Within a few breaths, the subtlest resonance tremors quietly emerged from the depths of the void.
The first thing that echoed was the ice-gold holy light of Amano Rinxing and the time-sequential thunder light of Yushen Cangshun. The coldness of the ice matched the clearness of the thunder, and the tolerance of time and space accepted the awe-inspiringness of the holy light. The two top powers gently collided and blended, creating a circle of fine and bright ripples of light.
Immediately afterwards, Fujisaki Wakaori's red flame spiritual power moved closer, the vitality of the vegetation nourished the time of time, and the red lotus fire tempered the evil spirits of thunder, perfectly filling the purifying vitality that the power of time and thunder lacked.
The power of water and wind of Haiyue Lianyin comes with the wind. The flowing water harmonizes the hostility of all things, and the breeze draws the spiritual power to flow, making the originally hard and sharp ice, fire, and thunder powers become harmonious and transparent, making movement and stillness suitable.
The earth and gold origin of the glazed golden flower is firmly at the bottom. The thick rock and soil is rooted in the earth, stabilizing the entire spiritual sound field. The sharp edge of the metal and stone strengthens the barriers of all forces, making the resonance of the six origins more stable, and there is no possibility of collapse.
Finally, the power of Yami Yumi's erratic purple-black phantom slowly merged into the center of the light array. The power of illusion that complemented reality and reality connected the gaps between the six origins, allowing all powers to completely merge into one, regardless of each other, and have the same origin.
Buzz——
A low and distant roar, originating from the origin of heaven and earth, echoed silently throughout the entire space.
No one could hear it, but it deeply shocked the blood and soul of every guardian present.
The origins of the six realms completely resonate, and the six lives and destiny are completely unified.
The six-color light surrounding the six people suddenly surged, turning into a brilliant array of light that penetrated the sky and the earth, suspended in the mid-air of the conference room. The six streams of ice white, crimson, blue, gilt, deep purple, and thunder blue are intertwined and interlocked in layers. The layers of spiritual power lines reproduce the prototype of the ancient Apocalypse Star Array, which is ancient, solemn, vast, and sacred.
The origin of Apocalypse, which was sleeping deep in the blood of the six people and had been completely silent since the catastrophe in the divine realm three years ago, quietly woke up at the moment when the power of the six royal families was perfectly unified.
The fine and pure starlight of the Apocalypse falls from the void, gently wrapping everyone's body and slowly seeping into the body along the texture and blood vessels. The original spiritual powers, which were originally independent and had different advancement trajectories, have completed the most perfect adaptation and interoperability under the nourishment of the power of Apocalypse.
Everyone's spiritual energy runs smoother and smoother, the foundations that have been worn for many years are nourished with gentleness, the minor injuries left by the fierce battles for days are healed, and the potential that has been dormant for many years in the body is awakened and unlocked bit by bit.
The majestic aura belonging to the complete Destiny Team suddenly spread out, covering the entire student union office building, and gently spreading to the entire Glazed Star Mian Academy.
The camphor branches and leaves that were originally swaying in the wind suddenly stopped outside the window. The birds in the forest stopped on the branches. The noisy campus people seemed to be gently isolated by invisible barriers. The whole world was silently surrendering to the apocalyptic scene of six lives united.
Amano Rinxing lowered his eyes slightly, feeling the unprecedented full strength in his body and the long-lost perfect resonance deep in his blood. His ice blue eyes were filled with calm relief and determination.
Three years of standing alone, three years of bearing the pressure alone, three years of watching my companions awaken one by one and returning to the team one after another. Today, I finally gathered all the members, gathered the destiny of the six domains, and completed the entire guardian star orbit.
He turned his eyes sideways, and his gaze subconsciously fell on Fujisaki Wakaori beside him.
The long hair of the girl Feixia was gently brushed by the starlight of the Apocalypse falling in the air. The fine firelight at the end of the hair was intertwined with the starlight, so gentle that it was almost unreal. She slightly raised her eyes to look at the apocalyptic light array in mid-air, her clear eyes filled with gentle light, her long eyelashes trembling slightly, and the lines on her profile were gentle and tough.
The skylight fell on the side of her fair face, outlining the soft jaw line, making her brows and eyes even more gentle and charming.
Amano Rinxing's heartbeat quietly slowed down by half a beat at this moment.
The vast and majestic apocalyptic spiritual power around him, the fate of the world, and the heavy battle between light and darkness seemed to have quietly shed their harsh and heavy shells at this moment, leaving only the gentle and touching appearance of the girl in front of him, which gently fell in his eyes and made tiny ripples in his heart.
The silent love that spans a long time, the countless times of side-by-side care, secret concern, and silent guarding in desperate situations, those tiny feelings hidden under calm restraint, under the gentle starlight in the sky at this moment, become clearer and hotter, spreading slowly along the blood, and the tenderness wraps up the entire mind.
He has always been calm, restrained and restrained, and is used to hiding all his emotions and worries deep in his heart, never showing any of them. But at this moment, looking at the girl standing side by side with him, who shares his destiny and walks the road together, the tenderness and throbbing that has been accumulated in his heart for a long time can no longer be easily concealed.
The gentle atmosphere of ambiguity spread silently, lingering between the two of them. It was light, long-lasting, sincere, not stained with impetuosity, leaving only sincerity and heartbeat running in both directions.
Fujisaki Wakaori seemed to be aware of it, and turned his head slightly, just in time to meet Amano Rinsei's gaze.
The young man's tall and elegant figure stood under the sky. His black hair with gradually changing golden tones was coated with a soft layer of gilding by the starlight. His ice-blue eyes were clear and clean. There was no sharpness in the battle or the heaviness of fate in his eyes. Only the gentleness and concentration that belonged to her were left, pure and hot.
The moment their eyes met, Fujisaki Wakaori's heart trembled slightly, and the tips of his ears were quietly dyed with a faint crimson color.
She quickly withdrew her gaze and looked back at the bright Apocalypse Star Array in mid-air. Her expression seemed calm, calm and indifferent, but her slightly trembling eyelashes quietly revealed the throbbing and panic in her heart.
The two-way love hidden under gentleness and forbearance needs no words or expressions. Between the silent gazes, the tenderness heats up and spreads quietly, becoming the gentlest and most tender touch of bright color in this heavy destiny.
The other four people around him were all immersed in the transformation of the body nourished by the power of the apocalypse and the transformation of the origin. No one noticed this fleeting, gentle and lingering moment of ambiguity. Only the breeze and starlight silently witnessed the two people's deep-seated hearts and two-way thoughts.
title_en: Chapter 21: The Beginning of the Apocalypse of Six Lives Returning to Heaven Chapter 22: The Truth of Betrayal in the Secret History of God’s Domain
